description: Single source of truth for the M17 ABI/toolchain gate. Every checker in the repository must read the ceilings from here instead of hardcoding them.

ceiling_rationale.glibc_max: public multi-device floor agreed for ArkOS/R36S class firmware
ceiling_rationale.glibc_preferred: ports/bully2/bully.glibc230 and ports/kotor/nxextract-ui already build at 2.17
ceiling_rationale.glibcxx_max: libstdc++.so.6.0.25 shipped by the pinned GCC 8.2.1 ARMHF sysroot
ceiling_rationale.cxxabi_max: libstdc++.so.6.0.25 shipped by the pinned GCC 8.2.1 ARMHF sysroot

search_paths.note: nxrelease.py rejects any RPATH/RUNPATH. ports/horizonchase/horizonchase-universal carries RUNPATH=[$ORIGIN] and therefore is a loader/relocation reference only, never a packaging reference.

wrapper_blacklist_note: Symbols whose glibc wrapper appeared after the preferred floor. Use a direct syscall() or a project shim instead. A null value means the symbol is only listed for review and never fails on its own.

sdl.floor_rationale: oldest SDL2 shipped by the supported multi-device firmware set

exceptions_note: Waivers are keyed by artifact sha256, so they die the moment the binary is rebuilt. A waiver never hides a finding; it downgrades it to a warning for an artifact that already carries physical evidence. Never add one for an artifact that has not been validated on hardware.

b5558457f7d778146b744111aeee7e73447f08e8.reason: approved ARMHF reference physically validated on R36S/ArkOS, where libEGL.so and libGLESv2.so exist; the canonical SONAME is required for any new build

c02b250c640e9696718f89dfff217ec7c620be8b.reason: approved AArch64 reference physically validated on Mali-450 and ArkOS with libGLESv2.so present

bd561ad5043e925c24e9fc45901a610df779da10.reason: historical, delisted and explicitly non-universal artifact; kept only as a narrow AArch64 loader reference at GLIBC_2.17

c50fa28454a5555788a272a85e6ee7b8b6ccfccf.reason: approved pad normaliser physically validated on R36S/ArkOS, whose SDL2 is newer than 2.0.6; the SDL floor still applies to any new port

horizonchase-runpath-origin.question: ports/horizonchase/horizonchase-universal carries RUNPATH=[$ORIGIN] and is recorded as a positive reference in framework/catalog/abi-checks-v1.tsv, but nxrelease.py rejects any RPATH/RUNPATH. It is deliberately NOT waived here.
horizonchase-runpath-origin.default_answer: strict: horizonchase stays a loader/relocation reference and is never a packaging reference; a public ZIP still may not contain any RPATH/RUNPATH

nextos-current.note: NextOS/NextOS Elite exclusive artifact. Never a silent universal path; must be named <port>-nextos and must never enter a public ZIP.
